hooks.command: if ! command -v devbox >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'devbox not found on PATH — install: curl -fsSL https://get.jetify.com/devbox/install.sh | bash'; exit 0; fi; if [ -f devbox.json ]; then devbox install >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
f="$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)/cplat-ship.json"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/cplat" ship gate
f="$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)/cplat-app-ship.json"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/cplat" app-ship gate
